note: Backlog item 15, step 14.435. People whose «name» is descriptive text, found by that exact name. «author»: the person is a work's author linked only through work_author; the work's own author name and description were split before. It is renamed «to» (or its works go to the existing person «link_to») and gets a work_people row with «role», «hedge» and «certainty». «scribe»: the person is renamed «to» on every copy it scribed; «link_note» goes on the scribe link and shows in brackets, «label_raw» keeps the catalogue's word before the name, «note» becomes a copy note of type «transcription», «patron» adds a commissioner. «patron»: the person was the commissioner, not the scribe: the scribe link becomes a name-only patron row «to» and the copy's commissioned_by. «remove»: no name at all: the link goes, «note» becomes a copy note, «copy_date_raw» the copy date when it has none. A person left with no links is removed.
